# X-GM-RAW wire encoding, for TestGmailRawSearch. Gmail advertises LITERAL-
# after LOGIN, so a non-ASCII query up to 4096 bytes is a non-sync literal.

S: {gmail.greeting}
C: {t} CAPABILITY
S: * CAPABILITY {gmail.caps}
S: {t} OK Thats all she wrote! a1b2c3d4e5f6
C: {t} LOGIN "atrium.test@gmail.com" "app password"
S: {t} OK [CAPABILITY {gmail.authcaps}] atrium.test@gmail.com authenticated (Success)
C: {t} SELECT INBOX
S: * 4 EXISTS
S: * OK [UIDVALIDITY 1] UIDs valid.
S: * OK [UIDNEXT 105] Predicted next UID.
S: {t} OK [READ-WRITE] INBOX selected. (Success)

# ASCII: one quoted string, quote and backslash escaped, no CHARSET.
C: {t} UID SEARCH X-GM-RAW "from:\"Jane Doe\" subject:(a\\b) in:anywhere"
S: * SEARCH 101
S: {t} OK SEARCH completed (Success)

# Empty query.
C: {t} UID SEARCH X-GM-RAW ""
S: * SEARCH
S: {t} OK SEARCH completed (Success)

# Non-ASCII: CHARSET UTF-8 and a literal of the UTF-8 bytes.
C: {t} UID SEARCH CHARSET UTF-8 X-GM-RAW {13+}
C: subject:été
S: * SEARCH 103
S: {t} OK SEARCH completed (Success)

# Non-ASCII with quotes: the literal carries them unescaped.
C: {t} UID SEARCH CHARSET UTF-8 X-GM-RAW {38+}
C: from:"José Ñúñez" 東京 -in:chats
S: * SEARCH 102 103
S: {t} OK SEARCH completed (Success)

# One non-ASCII query switches the whole command to CHARSET UTF-8; the ASCII
# ones stay quoted, the rest of the command follows the literal.
C: {t} UID SEARCH CHARSET UTF-8 X-GM-RAW "has:attachment" X-GM-RAW {11+}
C: label:Été X-GM-RAW "older_than:1y"
S: * SEARCH
S: {t} OK SEARCH completed (Success)

# With UTF8=ACCEPT enabled the query is quoted UTF-8 and CHARSET is invalid.
C: {t} ENABLE UTF8=ACCEPT
S: * ENABLED UTF8=ACCEPT
S: {t} OK Success
C: {t} UID SEARCH X-GM-RAW "from:\"José Ñúñez\" 東京"
S: * SEARCH 102
S: {t} OK SEARCH completed (Success)

C: {t} LOGOUT
S: * BYE LOGOUT Requested
S: {t} OK 73 good day (Success)
